scoring_justification: Critical temperatures, compensation temperature, and coercive fields can be recomputed from the raw magnetization curves (mt_data.csv and mh_data.csv) using zero-crossing analysis; no dependence on agent self-reporting.

outputs.description: M‑T data for FM, EAFM, SAFM regimes. The checker will extract Tc and T_comp from the M_total column.
Hysteresis M‑H data for FM, EAFM, SAFM regimes at T=1,2,3,4. The checker will extract coercive fields from the M_total column.

required.Hc_values: array of objects each with T: number, case: string, Hc: number or array of numbers

outputs.description: Agent's extracted quantities. Cross‑checked for consistency with the recomputed values from mt_data.csv and mh_data.csv.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts must be written under /app/outputs. The checker recomputes critical quantities from the raw CSV files, not from the summary.json directly; the summary.json is validated against those recomputed values.
